verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official CLI with dedicated docs (cli-introduction). It covers a local dev server that executes tasks, and the changelog adds commands for projects, runs and environment management. Community users praise the dev mode, which the docs tie to the CLI dev command. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents), a full documented command reference for deploy/trigger operations, and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI itself beyond dev mode.
